Name: Ahio, Son of Abinadab
Summary: Ahio, son of Abinadab, walked before the ark with his brother Uzzah as it was brought up from Kirjath-jearim toward Jerusalem on a new cart.
KeyStory: Ahio walked before the ark on the day his brother died beside it.
RelatedPeople: Abinadab of Kirjath-jearim; Uzzah, Son of Abinadab; King David
LifeLesson: Walking before the ark is honour — and the day can still end in grief.
